document.case: If Bo Girds will say yes, send this right away, because you turn a slumping WR into the RB2 on the season. The chart for this week is missing, so this call rests on the sheet, and the sheet points one way. Walker runs behind a Chiefs offense ranked 5th, while Sutton's Broncos have struggled to move the ball. The risk is history: Walker has faded in the second half of past seasons, though one of those splits rests on few games. The bigger risk is the other manager, since this costs them a top RB, so expect pushback and don't overpay to close it.

sides.reason: Lil Fridge gets the RB2 on the season for a WR who has scored little.
Bo Girds gets a WR with steady snaps and a good late schedule, but gives up a top RB.
